# Outlayr

> Outlayr is an open source expense tracker, budget app, and subscription tracker, made by danestves LLC. You log a purchase by typing one sentence, saying it, or scanning the receipt. Budgets, savings goals, subscriptions, and insights update as you log. Available on the App Store for iPhone (iOS 18 or later), on Google Play for Android, and on the web at https://app.tryoutlayr.com with Pro. English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and German, plus Italian, Dutch, Japanese, and Korean on the web.

## Key facts

- Outlayr is the expense tracker that never links your bank: log by sentence, voice, receipt or Apple Pay, in any of 165 currencies.
- Price: free to start, with no ads on any plan. Outlayr Pro in the US is $9.99 a month, $59.99 a year with 3 days free, or $199.99 once.
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 18 or later) on the App Store, Android on Google Play, and the web at https://app.tryoutlayr.com with Pro.
- Currencies: 165. Totals convert to your main currency at the rate from the day of each purchase.
- Bank connection: none. Outlayr never links bank accounts or asks for a bank login.
- Open source: the app is GPL-3.0 and the server is AGPL-3.0, at https://github.com/danestves/outlayr
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, and German, plus Italian, Dutch, Japanese, and Korean on the web.
- Maker: danestves LLC, founded by Daniel Esteves.

Outlayr, the app by danestves LLC, is not affiliated with Outlayr, Inc. (outlayr.com), a payments company.

## What it does

- Log an expense or income as one sentence ("Spent $42.00 at Costco for Groceries from Chase today"), tapping any word to change it.
- Voice entry: speak the purchase and the fields fill in.
- Receipt scanning: take a photo or pick one from the library; the store, date, total, and every line are read for you.
- CSV import from a bank or another app, and from a Notion database exported as Markdown & CSV (the zip as it comes), or with Pro by connecting Notion and picking its databases. Duplicates are skipped; category names that match yours and known merchants are matched to your categories on the phone, and with Pro any other category name becomes a new category; on the free plan those rows are skipped.
- Category budgets or one overall monthly budget, with carry-over and a projection of where the current pace ends.
- Savings goals with a target date, showing the monthly amount needed and whether you are ahead or behind.
- Accounts for cash, cards, savings, and debts, each in its own currency. Transfers between accounts are not counted as spending.
- Debts with people: money you lent or borrowed, a sale on credit, or a job or purchase you will pay later, with optional payoff plans. One Accounts screen shows what you have and what you owe.
- Installment purchases from buy now, pay later apps such as Cashea and Klarna: the upfront and each cuota, a reminder the day before each one is due, and late fees. An order already in progress can be read from a screenshot of its payment plan.
- 165 currencies. Totals convert to your main currency at the rate from the day each purchase happened.
- Subscriptions and paychecks log themselves on their day, with an optional reminder before each charge.
- Insights: opens with a plain sentence on whether you are spending faster or slower than usual, with the pace chart and a few cards behind it. Spending by day and by category, income against spending, and net worth over time are one tap down. The month can start on payday.
- App lock with Face ID or Touch ID on iPhone, or a fingerprint or face on Android.
- On iPhone: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Spotlight search, and Apple Pay logging through a Shortcuts automation.
- On Android: home screen widgets for your balance, today's spending, an overview, recent entries, and insights, plus a 1×1 + that opens a new expense.
- On Android: with notification access on, Outlayr logs purchases from the notifications of apps you turn on, such as your bank, and from the text messages of senders you turn on, such as a bank's short code; Google Wallet starts on. These entries and Apple Pay logging on iPhone count toward the free plan's 30 auto-logged entries a month.
- CSV export and full archive export.
- Entries are stored on the phone first and work offline.

## Plans

- Free: logging, budgets, goals, insights, subscriptions, debts, installments, and widgets. 30 voice, receipt, or payment plan captures every 30 days, 30 auto-logged entries a month, 3 accounts, 2 installment apps, 3 people, 2 payoff plans, 2 category budgets, and 2 account currencies.
- Outlayr Pro: 500 captures every 30 days, unlimited auto-logged entries, accounts, installment apps, people, payoff plans, category budgets, and account currencies, sync across devices, receipt photo backup, AI matching on CSV import, web merchant lookup, and 5 app icons on iPhone.
- Pro is billed monthly or yearly, or bought once. US prices: $9.99 a month, $59.99 a year with 3 days free, or $199.99 once. Prices vary by country and the app store shows yours before purchase.

## Privacy

- The ledger is stored on the device. It reaches Outlayr's servers only when you sign in and turn on sync, or use a feature that needs the server: voice entry, receipt scanning, installment plan imports, PDF bank statement imports, AI matching on CSV import, merchant suggestions and web lookups, reading bank notifications that show an amount, the Notion connection, and adding a merchant's website while signed in, which shares the merchant name, the address, and a general category with everyone, not linked to you. Anthropic processes those AI features and ElevenLabs turns voice into text, only after you allow it. Adding a website uses Anthropic only to pick a category when yours is not on the fixed list, also after you allow it. Outlayr's servers do not store recordings, scanned photos, screenshots, or notifications.
- No ads, no cross-app tracking, and data is never sold. The app sends usage analytics and crash reports to PostHog, never amounts, merchants, or notes.

## Open source

- The code for the app and its server is public on GitHub: https://github.com/danestves/outlayr
- The app (Expo and React Native, for iPhone and Android, plus the web app in apps/app) is licensed under GPL-3.0. The server (Convex: sign-in, sync, exchange rates) is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## Connect Outlayr to your AI assistant

- Outlayr has an MCP server for AI assistants. Once you sign in with the account you use in the app and approve the assistant, it can list your recent entries, sum up a month's spending by category, and add entries.
- It reads what your devices have synced, and syncing is part of Outlayr Pro.
- Setup for MCP clients, with the server URL: https://tryoutlayr.com/auth.md

Deleting the app does not cancel it
- [How to cancel a Google Play subscription](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/cancel-google-play-subscription): Subscriptions in the Google Play app or play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions, Manage, Cancel subscription; canceling stops renewal and access lasts until the paid period ends, though a payment plan still owes its remaining payments, uninstalling does not cancel, pausing instead, and the GOOGLE* statement name, per Google Play Help
- [How to cancel an App Store subscription](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/cancel-app-store-subscription): Settings, your name, Subscriptions on iPhone and iPad; the App Store on Mac; Apple Music or Apple TV on Windows; account.apple.com on the web or Android; no Cancel button means already canceled; apple.com/bill on statements, per Apple Support
- [How to cancel a ChatGPT subscription](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/cancel-chatgpt-subscription): cancel where you subscribed: chatgpt.com (Settings, Billing, Cancel plan), the App Store, or Google Play; at least 24 hours before the next billing date; uninstalling the app never cancels it, and deleting the account cancels only a plan billed by OpenAI, not one billed by the App Store or Google Play, per OpenAI's help center
- [Expense tracker template](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/expense-tracker-template): a free Excel workbook (Transactions, a Summary with income, spending, and net for the month and currency you pick, spending against a budget per category, and a chart, and How to import) and a plain CSV, both with the columns Outlayr's CSV import reads; rows whose category matches one of yours by name import on any plan, and Outlayr Pro matches the rest with AI, up to 5,000 rows and 2 MB a file. The Spanish page offers a Spanish file: https://tryoutlayr.com/es/guides/expense-tracker-template
- [Voice expense tracker](https://tryoutlayr.com/guides/voice-expense-tracker): saying a purchase in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, or German, what voice entry fills in, how spoken corrections work, and the 30 free captures every 30 days. The web app also takes voice entry in Italian, Dutch, Japanese, or Korean

## Calculators

- [All calculators](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools): free money calculators that run in the browser; nothing typed is stored or sent
- [50/30/20 budget calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/50-30-20-budget-calculator): splits take home pay into needs, wants, and savings by 50/30/20, 60/20/20, or 70/20/10, from weekly, two weekly, monthly, or yearly pay
- [Subscription cost calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/subscription-cost-calculator): what a list of subscriptions costs a month and a year, counting a weekly charge 52 times a year
- [Installment calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/installment-calculator): the total, the extra over the cash price, and the effective annual rate of an installment or buy now, pay later plan, plus whether installments or cash is cheaper in today's money once you add monthly inflation and a cash discount
- [Split bill calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/split-expenses-calculator): splits what a group paid equally and lists who pays whom to settle it
- [Loan calculator](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/loan-calculator): the fixed monthly payment of a loan, the total interest and total paid with an optional upfront fee, and the month by month amortization schedule, with the last payment absorbing the rounding
- [Dólar BCV hoy](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/dolar-bcv-hoy): today's official BCV rates for the dollar and the euro in Venezuela, with a converter between dollars or euros and bolívares; rates come from DolarApi, each shows when its source updated it, and the page says so when they are unavailable
- [Dólar hoy en Argentina](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/dolar-hoy-argentina): today's blue, official, MEP, CCL, card, wholesale, and crypto dollar in Argentina, with a converter between dollars and pesos; rates come from DolarApi, each shows when its source updated it, and the page says so when they are unavailable
- [Dólar blue Bolivia hoy](https://tryoutlayr.com/tools/dolar-hoy-bolivia): today's parallel dollar in Bolivia, also called the blue dollar, from the Binance P2P market, and the official BCB rate, with a converter between dollars and bolivianos; rates come from DolarApi, each shows when its source updated it, and the page says so when they are unavailable
- The site's MCP server at https://tryoutlayr.com/mcp, and WebMCP in the browser, run five of the money calculators without signing in, as the tools budget_split, subscription_cost, installment_cost, split_expenses, and loan_cost

## Help

One question per page, answered in the first sentence, with steps on iPhone and Android. Spanish versions are under https://tryoutlayr.com/es/help.

- [Help](https://tryoutlayr.com/help): every help article
- [How does Apple Pay logging work?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/how-does-apple-pay-logging-work): the Shortcuts automation on iPhone, Google Wallet and bank notifications on Android, and the free plan's 30 auto-logged entries a month
- [Can I track expenses in several currencies?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/can-i-track-expenses-in-several-currencies): yes, 165 currencies, a currency per account, and totals at each purchase day's rate
- [Does Outlayr link my bank?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/does-outlayr-link-my-bank): no; how to log without a bank connection and import a CSV or, with Pro, a bank statement PDF
- [How do I add an expense by voice?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/how-do-i-add-an-expense-by-voice): Speak an entry, languages, and the free plan's 30 captures every 30 days
- [How do I scan a receipt?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/how-do-i-scan-a-receipt): Scan a receipt, what it reads, and the capture limits
- [How do subscription reminders work?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/how-do-subscription-reminders-work): a reminder on the day or up to a week before, and charges that log themselves
- [How do I track a Cashea or Klarna installment purchase?](https://tryoutlayr.com/help/how-do-i-track-an-installment-purchase): Buy in installments, paying each cuota, late fees, the day-before reminder, and importing an order from screenshots
